items.text: Athletics trade Ryon Healy to the Mariners for Emilio Pagan and Alexander Campos
Padres trade Jon Adkins and Ben Johnson to the Mets for Heath Bell and Royce Ring
Twins trade Matt Kinney and Javier Valentin to the Brewers for Matt Yeatman and Jerry Oakes
Padres trade Gene Kingsale to the Tigers for Mike Rivera
Reds trade Jack Armstrong, Scott Scudder and Joe Turek to the Indians for Greg Swindell
Indians trade Don Lovell and John Githens to the Orioles for Tom Magrann and Jerry Holtz
Cardinals trade Jimmie Wilson to the Phillies for Spud Davis and Eddie Delker
